title: ActivityProfile
description: What a person wants from the weather before they will go outside. Extracted from natural language once, confirmed by the user, then read by the scoring engine on every request.

activity.description: What the person does outdoors, in one lowercase word.

wind_max_kmh.description: Highest acceptable wind speed in km/h.

precip_max_pct.description: Highest acceptable chance of precipitation, as a percentage.

uv_max.description: Highest acceptable UV index, or null if the person did not say.

preferred_hours.description: The hours of day the person prefers, as [start, end] in local time. Without this term the engine ranks 03:00 as the best hour of the week.
